## What you did
• You solved the Zest Grocers timeout by converting CSV export to a streaming background job with email notifications, ready in PR #430 [2].
• You shipped the v2 dashboard grid with snap-to-layout drag-and-drop, submitted as draft PR #427 [3].
• You refined the v2 interface: compressed widget headers, streamlined the action menu, localized cohort tooltips, and removed layout jumps on load [1].

## What changed
• Maya approved your v2 code but placed a hard stop on the Thursday Orbitly rollout because the export is missing from the new widget menu [7][10].
• Zest Grocers is urgently following up on the export result ahead of Monday’s operations review [9].
• Daniel gave his 👍 to PR #430, so it will merge immediately once CI clears [5].
• Sentry caught a crash when hovering empty cohorts, matching the bug you noted for today’s work [8].

## What is still open
• Fix the RetentionChart crash on empty data points and surface “No data yet” to unblock the Thursday release [1][8].
• Restore the export entry in the v2 widget menu so the new async flow replaces v1 cleanly [2][10].
• Verify the export integration on staging and enable the `dashboards_v2` flag for Orbitly on Thursday [7][10].
• Determine whether to retire `@chartkit/react` separately, since Maya wants to keep it until legacy v1 traffic dies out [7].
